performance.verdict: Meta carrying all leads; Google spend is waste until overdue SOW blockers clear.

findings.text: 6 overdue SOW milestones (earliest: 2026-07-31) — Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site Live, Ads Launch, Meta Retargeting, and Shoot 1 — all unconfirmed. Ops/Google Ads/Web/Meta all blocked.
Meta CPL is effectively $51.42 (35 leads / $1,799.59) vs Google's $1,983.36 for 1 conversion — 97% of leads came from Meta at 38x better efficiency.
3-day lead signal (Oct 25–27): 3+0+2=5 leads vs prior 3 days (Oct 22–24): 2+2+1=5 leads — flat momentum despite Meta spend holding ~$69–80/day. CPL stable, not improving further.
GHL shows 105 opportunities from 316 contacts (28 days) with 0 won and 0 appointments — leads entering CRM but no consults booked, suggesting intake or booking automation is broken.
GBP actions dropped 51.11% week-over-week; last 3 days show 4+0+0 actions vs prior 3 days' 3+7+0. Organic visibility deteriorating alongside paid.

suggestions.text: Shift $20/day from Google Search to Meta — Google produced 1 conversion on $1,983.36 vs Meta's 35 leads.
suggestions.monday_update: Move $20/day from the Google 'Leads - Search Campaign' to Meta, effective immediately. Sohib to approve before any platform change is made.

suggestions.text: Fix GHL intake: 105 opportunities, 0 appointments booked — diagnose booking link and auto-assignment routing immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 105 opportunities created from 316 contacts over 28 days with zero appointments and zero won deals — the consult booking step is not functioning. Audit the calendar booking link, auto-assignment rules, and first-contact automation (target: under 5 min per SOW). Success check: at least 1 confirmed booked appointment appearing in GHL within 7 days of fix, verified by 2026-11-04.
